content: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911). If the symptoms are not severe, contact a poison control center without delay. In the United States, you can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. In Canada, the number to call is 1-844-764-7669. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current medical condition. It should not be used for other conditions unless directed by your healthcare provider. If you miss a dose of this medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Medications should not be flushed down the toilet or poured into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Dispose of this product properly when it is expired or no longer needed. The information provided here was last revised in May 2024. It is important to note that this is a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. This information does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. It is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
